lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-lateral flank. Posterior to the pectoral fin, these spots are arranged in identifiable vertical columns and horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like lattice, most prominent in the region posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal aspect to shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the leading edge and base.
